content: 1. Zanubrutinib: Avoid coadministration of zanubrutinib, a CYP3A4 substrate, with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. If unavoidable, increase the zanubrutinib dose to 320 mg orally twice daily. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inducer, resume the previous zanubrutinib dose. 2. Zuranolone: Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of zuranolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative therapies. 3. Abiraterone: Nafcillin decreases abiraterone levels by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. If unavoidable, increase abiraterone dosing frequency from once daily to twice daily. 4. Acalabrutinib: Nafcillin reduces acalabrutinib levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Aspirin: Nafcillin and aspirin may increase each other's levels through plasma protein binding competition or by reducing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor. 6. Atezolizumab: Nafcillin may reduce the therapeutic effects of atezolizumab through an unspecified mechanism. Use caution and monitor, as coadministration may interfere with immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. 7. Atogepant: Nafcillin decreases atogepant levels via CYP3A4 induction. Adjust atogepant dosage to 30 mg or 60 mg daily when coadministered with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 8. Avelumab: Nafcillin may reduce the therapeutic effects of avelumab through an unspecified mechanism. Use caution and monitor, as coadministration may interfere with immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. 9. Balstilimab: Nafcillin may reduce the therapeutic effects of balstilimab through an unspecified mechanism. Use caution and monitor, as coadministration may interfere with immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. 10. Bazedoxifene/Conjugated Estrogens: Nafcillin reduces the levels of these hormones by altering intestinal flora or inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This applies only to oral forms, with a low risk of contraceptive failure. Use caution and monitor. 11. Belumosudil: Nafcillin decreases belumosudil levels via CYP3A4 induction. Increase the belumosudil dose to 200 mg orally twice daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 12. Bendroflumethiazide: Nafcillin and bendroflumethiazide may increase each other's levels by reducing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor. 13. Benzhydrocodone/Acetaminophen: Nafcillin reduces benzhydrocodone levels via CYP3A4 induction. Discontinuation of CYP3A4 inducers may increase hydrocodone plasma concentrations, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Brexpiprazole: Nafcillin decreases brexpiprazole levels via CYP3A4 induction. Double the brexpiprazole dose over 1–2 weeks if coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. 15. Bromocriptine: Nafcillin reduces bromocriptine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 16. Budesonide: Nafcillin reduces budesonide levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 17. Buprenorphine: Nafcillin reduces buprenorphine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Monitor for withdrawal symptoms in patients on buprenorphine subdermal implants or long-acting injections. Adjust therapy or consider alternative formulations if necessary. 18. Cabazitaxel: Nafcillin reduces cabazitaxel levels via CYP3A4 induction. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 19. Calcifediol: Nafcillin reduces calcifediol half-life by stimulating microsomal hydroxylation. Use caution and monitor. 20. Cannabidiol: Nafcillin reduces cannabidiol levels via CYP3A4 induction. Consider increasing the cannabidiol dose based on clinical response and tolerability. 21. Chloramphenicol: Chloramphenicol antagonizes the bactericidal effects of nafcillin. Use caution and monitor. 22. Chlordiazepoxide: Nafcillin reduces chlordiazepoxide levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 23. Citalopram: Nafcillin reduces citalopram levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 24. Clonazepam: Nafcillin reduces clonazepam levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 25. Conjugated Estrogens (Vaginal): Nafcillin reduces the levels of conjugated estrogens via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 26. Crizotinib: Nafcillin reduces crizotinib levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 27. Cyclosporine: Nafcillin reduces cyclosporine levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 28. Dantrolene: Nafcillin reduces dantrolene levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 29. Darifenacin: Nafcillin reduces darifenacin levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 30. Darunavir: Nafcillin reduces darunavir levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 31. Deflazacort: Both nafcillin and deflazacort decrease serum potassium. Use caution and monitor. 32. Diazepam (Buccal/Intranasal): Nafcillin reduces diazepam levels via CYP3A4 induction, potentially decreasing efficacy. Use caution and monitor. 33. Digoxin: Nafcillin increases digoxin levels by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms. Use caution and monitor. 34. Diltiazem: Nafcillin reduces diltiazem levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 35. Doxorubicin (Liposomal): Nafcillin reduces doxorubicin levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 36. Dronabinol: Nafcillin reduces dronabinol levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 37. Durvalumab: Nafcillin may reduce the therapeutic effects of durvalumab through an unspecified mechanism. Use caution and monitor. 38. Efavirenz: Nafcillin reduces efavirenz levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 39. Elagolix: Nafcillin reduces elagolix levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 40. Enzalutamide: Nafcillin reduces enzalutamide levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 41. Erlotinib: Nafcillin reduces erlotinib levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 42. Estradiol (Oral/Vaginal): Nafcillin reduces estradiol levels by altering intestinal flora or inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This applies only to oral forms, with a low risk of contraceptive failure. Use caution and monitor. 43. Ethinylestradiol: Nafcillin reduces ethinylestradiol levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 44. Ethosuximide: Nafcillin reduces ethosuximide levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 45. Etoposide: Nafcillin reduces etoposide levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 46. Exemestane: Nafcillin reduces exemestane levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 47. Felbamate: Nafcillin reduces felbamate levels via CYP3A4 induction. Use caution and monitor. 48. Fentanyl (All Forms): Nafcillin reduces fentanyl levels via CYP3A4 induction, potentially leading to withdrawal symptoms in dependent patients. After discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers, monitor for increased fentanyl plasma concentrations and associated effects.
